explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration for this. The theorem is the counit axiom for the library's own `externalTensorCoaction`: it combines a right C-comodule V and a right D-comodule W into a right (C ⊗ D)-comodule on V ⊗ W. So its content depends on the library's own `RightComodule` structure and `externalTensorCoaction` definition. I grepped Mathlib for "Comodule" and got no matches, so Mathlib has no comodule structures. The proof uses only general tensor-product facts (`tensorTensorTensorComm`, `rid`, `ext_fourfold'`, `counit_tmul`), and none of them carries the result on its own.
